build_multigrid_obs_preproc: build a module that preprocesses multigrid observations with conv filters and one-hot direction encoding
create_multigrid_dqn_networks: create a DQN feed-forward network for a multigrid environment using an MLP with 50-unit hidden layers
create_multigrid_ppo_networks: create PPO actor-critic networks for a multigrid environment with configurable hidden layer sizes
build_categorical_ppo_networks: build PPO networks with categorical policy sampling, log probability, and entropy from a feed-forward network
init_default_multigrid_network: initialize default PPO networks for a multigrid environment given an agent type and environment spec
